name: General site modifiers
description: Persistent conditions and transient weather compatible with multiple site generators

fields.name: Abandoned
fields.description: The place still partly functions, but its occupants left essential belongings behind.

fields.name: Immense
fields.description: Internal distances exceed expectations and demand supplies, navigation, or several stages of exploration.

fields.name: Heavy Rain
fields.description: Visibility is reduced, exposed ground turns muddy, tracks wash away, and leaks or rising water threaten low areas.

fields.name: Thunderstorm
fields.description: Heavy rain and strong wind batter the site while thunder masks distant sounds and lightning endangers exposed heights.

fields.name: Dense Fog
fields.description: Visibility falls to a short distance, making landmarks, ranged observation, and long-distance orientation unreliable.

fields.name: Strong Winds
fields.description: Exposed movement, projectiles, loose objects, open flames, and elevated structures become difficult to manage.

fields.name: Heavy Snow
fields.description: Falling snow reduces visibility and movement; fresh tracks stand out before gradually filling.

fields.name: Cold Snap
fields.description: Exposed water freezes, surfaces become slick, and prolonged outdoor activity demands shelter and warmth.

fields.name: Heat Wave
fields.description: Shade and drinking water become important, and prolonged exertion in exposed areas quickly becomes exhausting.

fields.name: Hailstorm
fields.description: Hard impacts make exposed travel difficult and create constant noise on roofs, armor, and bare ground.

fields.name: Dust Storm
fields.description: Airborne dust obscures landmarks, irritates breathing, and makes exposed routes difficult to navigate.

fields.name: Ashfall
fields.description: Fine ash coats surfaces, obscures distant landmarks, reveals recent passage, and contaminates exposed supplies.
